physics.environment_support_provenance: Single controllable right hand: fixture supports the uncontrolled target in place of the omitted supporting hand. Fixed at task initialization; never reference-driven during rollout.
physics.provenance: EgoEngine reproduction build_scene/build_scene_batched friction=1.0; explicit hand/tool collision material, preserve authored materials and table settings

controller_provenance: previous EgoEngine XHand reproduction external-wrench PD gains, force clamps and gravity feedforward; source-clock world linear and angular velocity targets are both tracked | Wrist PD for acquisition (diagnostic scripts/diagnose_wrist_drive.py, outputs wrist_diag_d1/d2): linear kp 1200 / kd 40 (1.122 kg hand: omega_n 33 rad/s, zeta 0.55; the reproduction tuned 300/12 for a 0.19 kg hand) and rotational kp 6 / kd 0.08 (palm link I 0.00035-0.00068 kg m^2 keeps explicit damping below the original 0.12; the previous kp 2 left 0.055 rad finger-closure twist, now 0.017 rad in the diagnostic). Clamps unchanged (30 N, 2 N m). | hit3: rotational damping back to 0.12 (kp_rot 6 kept). With kd_rot 0.08 the held knife (Cut 040) rang at |w| p95 14 rad/s vs 4.5 commanded; 0.12 is the long-used original damping (Pour 246 p95 3.3 rad/s).
finger_drive_provenance: Shared research gains: reduce observed 0.03-0.075 rad load deflection of a 0.5 mm geometric grasp; preserve 3 Nm effort limit; fresh physical validation required

planning.note: Nominal floating-wrist planning budgets, not physical hardware ratings; actual contact and tracking are checked in PhysX.

wrist_chart_provenance.rule: maximise the smallest |cos(ZYX pitch)| of the measured hand orientations; planning chart only

egoengine_alignment.provenance: EgoEngine Sec. 3.2: Mink Eq.(1) reference, Replay executes it directly, MPC mode = SPIDER sampling (the paper's MPC baseline); our PhysX acceptance gates and source clock unchanged

ppo.provenance: wider residual (wrist ±4 cm/±0.3 rad, fingers ±0.3 rad) and 420 s budget for thin-handle acquisition; default stays ±2 cm/±0.2 rad, 240 s | residual_smoothing 0.2: first-order smoothing of the per-frame PPO residual (EgoEngine C.3 has an action-smoothness term; the project set it to 0)

carry.provenance: fade the measured carry-entry offset to the source-aligned drive over 1 s (default: minimum nominal handoff); plus 0.15 rad grip preload along the XHand closing direction at carry start

single_object_variant: floating_xhand_egoengine_hit3s.json with no fixed target: single-object tasks (EgoEngine-release Aria mustard pick-and-place) have only the manipulated tool; everything else unchanged.
